242513.desc: Increases the equipper's Receive stat by {0}%.\nWhen the equipper performs a Receive, your side's back row players' Defense Technique increases by {1}%, stacking up to {2} times.\nWhile the equipper is on the court, when your side's players use a Receive skill, the receiving player recovers {3} Stamina and gains {4}% Power Attack/Quick Attack, lasting for {5} net crossings.

242715.name: Defense Boost: MICHINARI AKAGI
242715.desc: Increases the equipper's Receive stat by {0}%.\nWhen the equipper performs a Receive or Save that is not BAD, allied players gain {1}% Defense Technique, stacking up to {2} times, lasting for {3} turn.

245101.name: Overall DEF Boost: YU NISHINOYA (After-School)
245101.desc: Increases the equipper's Receive stat by {0}%.\nWhen the equipper uses an Ultimate, increases Reflex and Spirit by {1}% and {2}% respectively, stacking up to {3} times.\nIf the equipper uses Ultimates {5} or more times within {4} wihtin a rally, the equipper recovers {6} Stamina and gains {7}% DEF Technique for the next Ultimate use, lasting for {8} net crossings.

245303.name: Receive & Spirit Boost: MORISUKE YAKU (Fireworks Festival)
245303.desc: Increases equipper's Receive stat by {0}%; when equipper's ball contact result is PERFECT, increases Spirit by {1}%, up to {2} stacks

245507.name: Receive & Touch Boost: HARUKI KOMI (School Festival)
245507.desc: Increases the equipper's Receive stat by {0}%; when the team's Morale is more than {1} points, the power of the equipper's touches increases by {2}% of the corresponding stat.

245903.name: Receive Boost: YU NISHINOYA (Jazz)
245903.desc: Increases equipper's Receive stat by {0}%; when equipper touches the ball, increases equipper's Spirit by {1}%, up to {2} stacks; also increases equipper's Receive stat by {3}% of their Save stat, up to {4} points

250001.name: Receive Boost: OP
250001.desc: When equipper enters the court for the first time in each match, increases their Receive stat by {0}% for {1} turns

250002.name: Serve Boost: KENTARO KYOTANI (Practice)
250002.desc: Increases equipper's Serve stat by {0}%; when equipper executes a Critical serve, increases this serve's power by {1}% of Serve stat

250003.name: Strength Boost: AKIRA KUNIMI
250003.desc: At the start of each turn, equipper receives {0} stacks of "Strength Boost", each stack increases equipper's Strength by {1}%, up to {2} stacks; when "Strength Boost" exceeds {3} stacks, increases equipper's Awareness by {4}%

250004.name: Spike Boost: DAICHI SAWAMURA (Practice)
250004.desc: When equipper receives, increases your side's next spike power by {0}% of the spiker's Power Attack or Quick Attack stat

250005.name: Basic Stats Boost: TARO ONAGAWA
250005.desc: At the start of each turn, increases equipper's Basic Stats by {0}%, stacking up to {1} times

250006.name: Defense Boost: HIROKI TAMAGAWA
250006.desc: When your side scores, increases equipper's Defense Technique by {0}%, stacking up to {1} times

251101.name: Receive/Power Attack Boost: DAICHI SAWAMURA
251101.desc: Increases equipper's Receive stat by {0}%; while equipper is on the court, your side's Power-type players receive {2} stacks of "Grit" for every {1} Stamina consumed, each stack increases Power Spike power by {3}% of Power Attack stat, up to {4} stacks

251216.name: Attack Boost: KENTARO KYOTANI
251216.desc: While the equipper is on the court, increases your side's Power-type players' Strength by {0}%; while the equipper is on the court, when an opponent player's Stamina drops below {1} points, reduces their Block stat by {2}% for {3} net crossings. Triggers up to {4} times per player per set

251503.name: Block & Power Attack Boost: TAKEHITO SASAYA
251503.desc: Increases equipper's Power Attack and Block stats by {0}%; when your side is behind, increases equipper's Power Spike power by {1}% of Power Attack stat.

251601.name: Awareness Boost: WAKATOSHI USHIJIMA
251601.desc: Increases equipper's Awareness by {0}%; when equipper's Awareness exceeds {1}%, gains {3}% Strength for every {2}% excess Awareness, up to {4}% Strength

251707.name: Reflex Boost: AKINORI KONOHA
251707.desc: Increases the equipper's Basic Stats by {0}%.\nThe equipper gains additional Reflex equal to {1}% of your Team Morale.\nWhile in [Team Moral Awakening], the equipper’s Reflex further increases by {2}%.

252711.name: Attack Boost: OSAMU MIYA
252711.desc: Increases the equipper’s Quick Attack stat by {0}%.\nIf the equipper’s Attack Technique is greater than {1}%, the spike’s power increases by {2}% of their Quick Attack stat.

255204.name: Strength & Power Attack Boost: WAKATOSHI USHIJIMA (Blazing Beach)
255204.desc: Increases equipper's Strength by {0}%; when your side is not in [Team Morale Awakening] state and equipper spikes, increases Power Attack stat by {1}% for {2} net crossings

255401.name: ATK & Stamina Boost: AKIRA KUNIMI (Sports Festival)
255401.desc: Increases the equipper's Power ATK stat by {0}%.\nWhen the equipper's Stamina is below {1} points, their ATK Technique increases by {2}%.\nEach time the equipper recovers Stamina, their Strength increases by {3}%, stacking up to {4} times.

255503.name: Overall Offense Boost: WAKATOSHI USHIJIMA (School Festival)
255503.desc: Increases equipper's Strength by {0}%; increases equipper's Awareness by {1}%; when equipper spikes, reduces Awareness by {2}% and increases Strength by {3}%, up to {4} stacks

255506.name: Receive & Power ATK Boost: AKINORI KONOHA (School Festival)
255506.desc: Increases the equipper's Receive stat by {0}%; when the equipper's Ultimate enters cooldown, the equipper's Power Attack increases by {1}%, up to {2}%, lasting until his next spike.

255603.name: Quick ATK & Strength Boost: OSAMU MIYA (Winter Break)
255603.desc: Increases the equipper's Quick ATK stat by {0}%. When your side performs a Set, the equipper's Strength increases by {1}%, stacking up to {2} times. When the equipper performs a Set, they gain an additional {3} stack(s).

256002.name: Power Attack & Receive Boost: DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Flag)
256002.desc: Increases equipper's Power Attack stat by {0}%; for every {1} players on your side from the same school as the equipper, increases equipper's Receive stat by {2}%
